# Terraform MongoDB Atlas Users Management Module (Generic)

 [![Latest Release](https://img.shields.io/github/release/cloudopsworks/terraform-module-mongoatlas-users.svg?style=for-the-badge)](https://github.com/cloudopsworks/terraform-module-mongoatlas-users/releases/latest) [![Last Updated](https://img.shields.io/github/last-commit/cloudopsworks/terraform-module-mongoatlas-users.svg?style=for-the-badge)](https://github.com/cloudopsworks/terraform-module-mongoatlas-users/commits)


Generic MongoDB Atlas Users Management Module provides cloud-provider-agnostic user management for MongoDB Atlas clusters. It handles automated password rotation, role-based access control, and outputs structured credentials for consumption by cloud-specific wrapper modules (aws-users, gcp-users, azurerm-users). The module supports multiple user configurations, custom rotation periods, and specialized scopes for precise access control.


---

## Introduction

This Terraform module provides a cloud-provider-agnostic solution for managing MongoDB Atlas users and their security configurations. Key features include:

- Automated user creation and management
- Customizable password rotation policies via `time_rotating`
- Support for externally-managed password rotation (e.g. AWS Lambda, GCP Cloud Function, Azure Function)
- Role-based access control with granular permissions
- Support for project and cluster-level scopes
- Structured credential output (`credentials`) for consumption by cloud-specific secret store modules
- Hoop.dev connection metadata output (`hoop_output`) for use with `terraform-module-hoop-connection`
- Custom connection string generation

This module has **no AWS, GCP, or Azure provider dependencies**. Use the cloud-specific wrapper modules
(`terraform-module-aws-mongoatlas-users`, `terraform-module-gcp-mongoatlas-users`,
`terraform-module-azurerm-mongoatlas-users`) to store credentials in the appropriate secret store.

## Usage


**IMPORTANT:** The `master` branch is used in `source` just as an example. In your code, do not pin to `master` because there may be breaking changes between releases.
Instead pin to the release tag (e.g. `?ref=vX.Y.Z`) of one of our [latest releases](https://github.com/cloudopsworks/terraform-module-mongoatlas-users/releases).


### Terragrunt Configuration
To use this module in your Terragrunt configuration, you can include it in your `terragrunt.hcl` file:

```hcl
terraform {
  source = "git::https://github.com/cloudopsworks/terraform-module-mongoatlas-users.git?ref=v2.0.0"
}

inputs = {
  # Organization and Environment Configuration
  org = {
    organization_name = "my-org"
    organization_unit = "my-unit"
    environment_type  = "prod"
    environment_name  = "production"
  }
  is_hub    = false # (Optional) Whether this is a hub or spoke configuration. Default: false.
  spoke_def = "001" # (Optional) Spoke definition. Default: "001".
  extra_tags = {   # (Optional) Extra tags to apply to all resources. Default: {}.
    "Owner" = "CloudOps"
  }

  # MongoDB Atlas Configuration
  # Provide either `project_id` or `project_name`.
  name_prefix  = "prod" # (Required) Prefix used to compose usernames when not explicitly provided.
  project_id   = "60f0f0f0f0f0f0f0f0f0f0f0" # (Optional) Atlas Project ID. One of `project_id` or `project_name` must be provided. Default: "".
  project_name = "my-project" # (Optional) Atlas Project Name. One of `project_id` or `project_name` must be provided. Default: "".
  region       = "us-east-1" # (Optional) Cloud provider region for username generation. Passed from cloud-specific wrapper modules. Default: "".

  # User Configuration (YAML Structure Documentation)
  # users:
  #   <user_key>:
  #     username: "user1" # (Optional) Explicit username; otherwise generated as `<name_prefix|user.name_prefix>-<system_name_short>-<user_key>`.
  #     name_prefix: "prefix1" # (Optional) Per-user prefix to build the username. Defaults to var.name_prefix.
  #     auth_database: "admin" # (Optional) Authentication database. Default: "admin".
  #     password_rotation_period: 90 # (Optional) Per-user rotation in days. Overrides var.password_rotation_period.
  #     import: false # (Optional) When true, imports an existing Atlas user instead of creating. Default: false.
  #     role_name: "readwrite" # (Optional) Top-level primary role key for Hoop connection naming. Allowed: readwrite, read, dbadmin, admin, dbowner, owner, clusteradmin. Default: "default".
  #     roles: # (Required) MongoDB roles granted to this user.
  #       - role_name: "readWrite" # (Required) Common: read, readWrite, dbAdmin, dbOwner, userAdmin, clusterAdmin.
  #         database_name: "test" # (Required) Database the role applies to (e.g., "admin", "app_db").
  #         collection_name: "widgets" # (Optional) Collection the role is scoped to.
  #     scopes: # (Optional) Atlas scope bindings for the user.
  #       - name: "cluster-name" # (Required) Cluster or data lake name.
  #         type: "CLUSTER" # (Optional) Allowed: CLUSTER, DATA_LAKE. Default: "CLUSTER".
  #     connection_strings: # (Optional) Include connection strings in credentials output.
  #       enabled: false # (Optional) When true, include public/private connection strings for `cluster`. Default: false.
  #       cluster: "cluster0" # (Required if enabled) Atlas Cluster name.
  #       endpoint_id: "vpce-0123456789abcdef" # (Optional) Private endpoint ID for PrivateLink strings.
  #       database_name: "mydatabase" # (Optional) Database name appended to the URI.
  #     hoop: # (Optional) Per-user Hoop.dev overrides.
  #       import: false # (Optional) When true, imports this user's existing Hoop connection. Default: false.
  #       access_control: [] # (Optional) Per-user access control list merged with global hoop.access_control. Default: [].
  users = {
    "app-user" = {
      roles = [
        {
          role_name     = "readWrite"
          database_name = "app_db"
        }
      ]
      connection_strings = {
        enabled = true
        cluster = "cluster0"
      }
    }
  }

  # Hoop Configuration (YAML Structure Documentation)
  # hoop:
  #   enabled: false # (Optional) Whether to enable Hoop.dev connection metadata output. Default: false.
  #   agent_id: "xxxxxxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx" # (Required if enabled) Hoop.dev agent ID (UUID) for hoop_output generation.
  #   tags: # (Optional) Free-form tags for Hoop connections. Default: {}.
  #     key: "value"
  #   access_control: [] # (Optional) Global access control list for all Hoop connections. Merged with per-user users[*].hoop.access_control. Default: [].
  hoop = {
    enabled  = true
    agent_id = "xxxxxxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx"
    tags     = { environment = "production" }
  }

  # Password Management
  password_rotation_period    = 90    # (Optional) Default rotation in days for all users (1-365). Overridden per user via users[*].password_rotation_period.
  password_externally_managed = false # (Optional) When true, sets an initial password but skips time_rotating. Use when an external system manages rotation.
  force_reset                 = false # (Optional) Force-reset credentials (break-glass).
}
```

### Full YAML Variables Documentation
```yaml
name_prefix: "atlas" # (Required) Prefix used to compose usernames when users[<key>].username is not provided. Allowed: lowercase letters, numbers, hyphens. No default.
project_id: "60f0f0f0f0f0f0f0f0f0f0f0" # (Optional) Atlas Project ID. One of `project_id` or `project_name` must be provided. Default: "".
project_name: "my-project" # (Optional) Atlas Project Name. One of `project_id` or `project_name` must be provided. Default: "".
region: "us-east-1" # (Optional) Cloud provider region for username generation. Passed from cloud-specific wrapper modules. Default: "".
users:
  <user_key>:
    username: "user1" # (Optional) Explicit username. If omitted, composed as `<name_prefix|user.name_prefix>-<system_name_short>-<user_key>`. Default: generated.
    name_prefix: "prefix1" # (Optional) Per-user prefix to build the username. If omitted, uses var.name_prefix. Default: null.
    auth_database: "admin" # (Optional) Authentication database. Common: "admin". Default: "admin".
    password_rotation_period: 90 # (Optional) Rotation period in days for this user. Overrides var.password_rotation_period. Default: var.password_rotation_period.
    import: false # (Optional) When true, imports an existing MongoDB Atlas user instead of creating a new one. Default: false.
    role_name: "readwrite" # (Optional) Top-level primary role key used for Hoop connection naming. Allowed: readwrite, read, dbadmin, admin, dbowner, owner, clusteradmin. Default: "default".
    roles: # (Required) MongoDB roles granted to this user.
      - role_name: "readWrite" # (Required) Built-in or custom role name. Common built-ins: read, readWrite, dbAdmin, dbOwner, userAdmin, clusterAdmin. No default.
        database_name: "test" # (Required) Database that the role applies to (e.g., "admin", "test", "app_db"). No default.
        collection_name: "widgets" # (Optional) Collection the role is scoped to (if applicable). Default: null.
    scopes: # (Optional) Atlas scope bindings for the user.
      - name: "cluster-name" # (Required) Target cluster or data lake name. No default.
        type: "CLUSTER" # (Optional) Scope type. Allowed: CLUSTER, DATA_LAKE. Default: "CLUSTER".
    connection_strings: # (Optional) Include connection strings in credentials output.
      enabled: false # (Optional) When true, include public/private connection strings for `cluster`. Default: false.
      cluster: "cluster0" # (Required if enabled) Atlas Cluster name used to resolve connection strings. No default.
      endpoint_id: "vpce-0123456789abcdef" # (Optional) Private endpoint ID to build PrivateLink connection strings. Default: "".
      database_name: "mydatabase" # (Optional) Database name appended in the connection string. Default: "".
    hoop: # (Optional) Per-user Hoop.dev integration overrides.
      import: false # (Optional) When true, imports this user's existing Hoop connection instead of creating a new one. Default: false.
      access_control: [] # (Optional) Per-user access control list merged with global hoop.access_control. Default: [].
hoop:
  enabled: false # (Optional) Enable Hoop.dev connection metadata output. Default: false.
  agent_id: "xxxxxxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx" # (Required if enabled) Hoop.dev agent ID (UUID) for hoop_output generation. No default.
  tags: # (Optional) Free-form tags to annotate the Hoop connection. Default: {}.
    key: "value"
  access_control: [] # (Optional) Global access control list applied to all Hoop connections. Merged with per-user users[*].hoop.access_control. Default: [].
password_rotation_period: 90 # (Optional) Default rotation period in days for all users (overridden by `users[*].password_rotation_period`). Allowed: 1-365. Default: 90.
password_externally_managed: false # (Optional) When true, sets an initial password but skips time_rotating rotation. Use when an external system manages rotation. Default: false.
force_reset: false # (Optional) Force-reset credentials even if unchanged (useful for break-glass scenarios). Default: false.
region: "us-east-1" # (Optional) Cloud provider region identifier for username generation. Default: "".
org:
  organization_name: "my-org" # (Required) Organization name.
  organization_unit: "my-unit" # (Required) Organization unit.
  environment_type: "prod" # (Required) Environment type.
  environment_name: "production" # (Required) Environment name.
is_hub: false # (Optional) Whether this is a hub or spoke configuration. Default: false.
spoke_def: "001" # (Optional) Spoke definition. Default: "001".
extra_tags: {} # (Optional) Extra tags to apply to all resources. Default: {}.
```

## Quick Start

1. **Terragrunt Setup**:
   Create a `terragrunt.hcl` file in your infrastructure repository.

2. **Configure Inputs**:
   Define your organization, project, and user requirements in the `inputs` block.

3. **Apply Configuration**:
   ```shell
   terragrunt run-all plan
   terragrunt run-all apply
   ```

4. **Consume Credentials**:
   The module outputs a `credentials` map (sensitive) and a `users` map (non-sensitive metadata).
   Pass `credentials` to the appropriate cloud-specific module for secret store storage:
   - `terraform-module-aws-mongoatlas-users` — stores in AWS Secrets Manager
   - `terraform-module-gcp-mongoatlas-users` — stores in GCP Secret Manager
   - `terraform-module-azurerm-mongoatlas-users` — stores in Azure Key Vault

5. **Hoop.dev Integration**:
   When `hoop.enabled = true` and `hoop.agent_id` is set, the `hoop_output` output provides
   connection metadata that cloud-specific wrapper modules enrich with secret store references
   before passing to `terraform-module-hoop-connection`.


## Examples

### Terragrunt Basic Example
```hcl
terraform {
  source = "git::https://github.com/cloudopsworks/terraform-module-mongoatlas-users.git?ref=v2.0.0"
}

inputs = {
  org = {
    organization_name = "cloudopsworks"
    organization_unit = "devops"
    environment_type  = "dev"
    environment_name  = "development"
  }
  name_prefix = "dev"
  project_id  = "5f7c8..."

  users = {
    "admin" = {
      roles = [
        {
          role_name     = "atlasAdmin"
          database_name = "admin"
        }
      ]
    }
  }
}
```

### Terragrunt Advanced Example with Connection Strings and Hoop Output
```hcl
terraform {
  source = "git::https://github.com/cloudopsworks/terraform-module-mongoatlas-users.git?ref=v2.0.0"
}

inputs = {
  org = {
    organization_name = "cloudopsworks"
    organization_unit = "devops"
    environment_type  = "prod"
    environment_name  = "production"
  }
  name_prefix  = "prod"
  project_name = "production-project"
  region       = "us-east-1"

  users = {
    "app-reader" = {
      username      = "reader-svc"
      auth_database = "admin"
      roles = [
        {
          role_name     = "read"
          database_name = "app_db"
        }
      ]
      connection_strings = {
        enabled     = true
        cluster     = "cluster-prod"
        endpoint_id = "vpce-0123456789abcdef"
      }
      hoop = {
        access_control = ["team-backend"]
      }
    }
  }

  hoop = {
    enabled  = true
    agent_id = "xxxxxxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx"
    tags     = { environment = "production", team = "backend" }
  }

  password_rotation_period = 30
}
```

## Outputs

|------|-------------|
